runtime_configuration.qualification: The initial command omitted the explicit staged-runtime module search path, so the compiler used its default closure runtime. Poisoning reproduced a stale closure directory in the unchanged standalone platform test, independent of this feature. Final focused and component commands use the production overlay path; generated-C excerpts and component metadata globals prove its presence. Earlier commands that omitted this path identify compiler bytes but do not establish use of the production closure overlay. Historical raw results remain unchanged. This is a test-configuration correction, not an engine/runtime change or an instruction saving.

qualification: Twelve final focused jobs pass (47 cases x 4 modes x 2 variants), including poisoned preallocation, ordinary GC, no GC and ASan/UBSan.
